modes.snapshot: Complete DOM snapshot with supporting telemetry; single-page unless link following is enabled.
modes.crawl: Follow links and return complete snapshots for multiple pages.
modes.full: Return every privacy-safe collector for the requested page set.
modes.content: Return rendered text, headings, and page identity.
modes.metadata: Return page identity, status, and headings only.
modes.links: Return discovered links and their rendered labels.
modes.forms: Return forms and input metadata without field values.
modes.scripts: Return external script inventory and source/sink indicators.
modes.dom_sinks: Focus on DOM sources, sinks, and inline event handlers.
modes.network: Return bounded request, response, and failure metadata.
modes.accessibility: Return a bounded semantic and interactive-element tree.
modes.performance: Return navigation, paint, and resource timing aggregates.
modes.screenshot: Capture viewport screenshots and minimal page metadata.
